power.capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on, 11 kW (the "Output kW" column of the maker's table). It is not what the PDU draws itself, which the basic version does not state

configs.description: The PDU as it ships: the fixed cord and the two push-button attachments on it. The universal mounting kit, the connector lock and the mounting adaptor are not drawn.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the data sheet says black anodised RAL 9005 ("other colours may be configured"); the photographs of the basic family show a natural silver extrusion and none is of this SKU. Silver is drawn.
gaps.wanted: a rating plate or order note naming the finish of this SKU.

gaps.note: the table prints 1095 and the drawing dimensions 1094. The drawing is used because every position is read off it.
gaps.wanted: the maker's word on which is the tolerance.

gaps.note: no photograph of this SKU shows what is printed beside the outlets; no name is taken, so the placement ids stand.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the printed outlet numbers.

gaps.note: the front view draws the cord and its plug across the first phase group, so part of that group's cell lines is hidden; the group is set from the lines that show and from the groups that do not have the cord over them.
gaps.wanted: a front view with the cord drawn away.

gaps.note: the phase groups are drawn as full-width plates in the colours of the DK 7979.175 render (the data sheet: L1 pink, L2 black, L3 white); no photograph of this SKU is held, the blank cells and the head cap are drawn in that model's end-cap colour, and the narrow margin each plate may leave at its edges is not measured.
gaps.wanted: a straight-on photograph of the front with a scale.

gaps.note: the mounting adaptor 7000.688 and the universal mounting kit are named and not drawn; the attachment on the enclosure frame at the side of the 19" frame is named and not dimensioned.
the end view draws the strip's section with the gland and the button and no detail; no photograph looks at an end or a side straight on.
gaps.wanted: straight-on photographs of an end and a side.
one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power` (profile `power` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

breakers.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "No. of circuit-breakers 2 (single-phase) or 6 (3-phase) with 32 A version"; the table prints this SKU at 16 A and the sheet's feature table has the breaker "only for 32 A PDU versions", so a 16 A version has none. No breaker is drawn and none is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - length 1094 (the dimension of the front view; the table of page 1 prints 1095), width 44 (the data sheet's "44 mm (1 U)"), depth 72.1 (the side view's dimension, the body from the front face to the back). The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) prints "PDU enclosure depth 70 mm" and the end view 109; the 109 is the body with the cable gland standing out of the front and the button out of the back, and the 70 is the extrusion profile, as the DK 7979.175 model reads the same figures. 72.1 is drawn.

colour.note: THE DATA SHEET AND THE PHOTOGRAPHS DISAGREE. The data sheet (dri1308088en, p.1) says "Aluminium, anodised in RAL 9005 (black, other colours may be configured)"; the photographs held of the basic family show a natural silver side, and none is of this SKU. The body is drawn silver as photographed (#b9bbbe, read by eye, estimated) and the disagreement is a gap.

dcim.note: the input is one power port from the cord part and each outlet a power outlet it feeds. C13 and C19 export as the IEC types; the CEE plug and the earthing-pin socket export as `other` with a label, because no upstream type for either has been read from a held source.

front.note: drawing - the front view of page 14, mm from the foot end: the foot cell 0 to 72.1 with the gland; a blank cell to 116.4 (44.3); phase 1, 116.4 to 383.5 (267.1); a blank cell to 427.6 (44.1); phase 2, 427.6 to 694.2 (266.6); a blank cell to 738.7 (44.5); phase 3, 738.7 to 1005.5 (266.8); a blank cell to 1077.8 (72.3); the head cap, 1077.8 to 1094, with its ribs. The cells are the ones this page draws, and no other page's. Each outlet stands in its cell as the DK 7979.175 model places it: the C13 long axis across the strip with the earth side toward the head, the C19 long axis along the strip with its earth slot toward the left of the face, the earthing-pin socket with its contact holes on one diagonal. Outlets count from the foot.

input.note: datasheet - dri1308088en p.1: "Input voltage range (L - N) 230 V (400 V, 3~), 50 - 60 Hz", "Input current 16 A/32 A (depending on product variant)", "No. of wires 3/5", "Connection cable type H05-VV", "Length of connection cable 3m"; the table: 3~, 16 A, 11 kW, input CEE. The circuit diagram draws the neutral to each phase group, so each outlet is line to neutral: `input-wiring: wye`. The unit has a fixed cord and no inlet. `plug-rating-a` is not written: the data sheet rates the unit, not the plug.

lifecycle.note: the maker's page lists the SKU among the 27 basic variants; no end-of-life notice was found in the pages read.

logo.note: no photograph of this SKU is held; the RITTAL mark of the basic family's renders is not drawn.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S DIMENSIONED DRAWING. Rittal, "Technical details, Power Distribution Unit, Basic version" (dri2108028en, 08.2023), PDF page 14, DK 7979.133: a plan view (the back), a side view, an end view and a front view, with the circuit diagram below. The cell lines of the front view were read from a 600 dpi render of that page at the drawing's own scale: the 1094 overall length between the two ends of the front view reads at 1.94 px per mm, the scale the DK 7979.175 page gives. Each cell edge is a full-height line of the front view. Good to about 1 mm. This page's own reading is used; no position is taken from another model. The offsets of an outlet in its cell are the DK 7979.175 model's. HIDDEN BY THE CORD: the cord and its plug lie across the first phase group's cells in the front view, so the first group's cell lines between 250 and 350 are hidden; its six cells are the same 44.4 as the two groups that show, from the pitch lines that show above the cord (116.3, 160.8, 205.3, 249.6).

mount.note: `rack-side`, the library's way to say a part stands vertically beside an upright, on the two push-button attachments of the plan view (dimensioned 933.45 apart, 80.4 in from the two ends). The data sheet's "PDU mounting options" are the enclosure frame at the side of the 482.6 mm mounting frame (zero-U space) and the cable route (push-button attachment); the mounting adaptor 7000.688 is an accessory and is not drawn. `ru: 25` is the 1094 mm it runs, 1094 / 44.45 = 24.6; the data sheet sells it by minimum rack height and not by rack units.

mounting-buttons.note: drawing - the plan view of page 14: two buttons 933.45 apart (dimensioned), their centres 80.4 and 80.15 in from the two ends of the 1094 (read from the two extension lines of the dimension); plate 25.2 along the strip. The foot end of the plan view is taken to be the end of the front view's foot cell.

outlets.note: datasheet and drawing - the table of page 1 ("PDU basic"): DK 7979.133, 3~, 16 A, 11 kW, CEE input, 18 CEE 7/3 earthing-pin sockets, six on each phase, 1095 mm; the circuit diagram draws six CEE 7/3 earthing-pin sockets on each of L1, L2 and L3 and numbers the outlets 1 to 18. rittal/cee-7-3-outlet@1. None is switched; none has a lamp. NO OUTLET NAME IS WRITTEN: no held photograph is of this SKU, so what the unit prints beside an outlet is not known, and the outlets keep their placement ids, counted from the foot.

rear.note: drawing - the plan view draws the same two long grooves, ridge and two buttons as the DK 7979.175 model reads, from 2.6 in of each end.
